# Castells Media

Full-service marketing agency for home service businesses in the United States.
One team runs all of a client's marketing every month: we build the website,
the Google and Yelp profiles, the ad accounts and the CRM when they are missing,
and then run all of it, so the phone rings and no request is left unanswered.

We do not sell single services or one-time setups.

Castells Media Inc, 1298 Antelope Creek Drive, Roseville, California.
Phone +1 (916) 619-6006. Email contact@castells.media.

## What is included

- People find you: website and landing pages, Google Business Profile, Yelp profile, local search pages
- Ads bring calls: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Yelp Ads, ad texts and creative
- No request gets lost: CRM on our own platform (Mosco), one inbox for calls, forms and messages, follow-up, reviews
- You see what it brings: call and form tracking, a weekly report in plain numbers

## Pricing and terms

- One monthly fee for all of the work, named on the first call
- No setup fee: the website, ad accounts and CRM are built as part of the monthly work
- Month to month, no contract
- The website, domain, ad accounts and customer list are in the client's name from day one
- The ad budget is billed by Google, Meta and Yelp directly to the client, and we take no cut of it
